translations.web: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us, and help us.”
translations.bsb: “It often throws him into the fire or into the water, trying to kill him. But if You can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”
translations.kjv: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
translations.asv: And oft-times it hath cast him both into the fire and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do anything, have compassion on us, and help us.
